variants.text: A young adult male with an oval face, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and short facial stubble along the jawline.

A young adult male with an oval face, moderate-height forehead with slight temporal recession, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight-bridged nose. He has balanced lips, a well-defined jawline with a rounded chin, and short facial stubble along the jawline.

Young adult male with an oval face shape, moderate brow ridge, and a rounded hairline with moderate temporal recession. Features prominent cheekbones, a well-defined jawline, and a rounded chin. He has almond-shaped eyes with double upper-lid creases, a straight nasal dorsum with a rounded tip, and balanced, full lips with a defined cupid's bow. Short facial stubble is present along the jawline.

This is a young man with an oval face and almond-shaped eyes. He has a straight nose, full lips, and a well-defined jawline with some short stubble along the chin. He has a bit of a receding hairline and is smiling in the photo.
